title: So Bad It's Good with Ryan Bailey
author: Studio71
description: When culture pops, so does Ryan Bailey. On So Bad It's Good, a daily podcast presented by Studio71, Ryan dissects the best (and worst) entertainment has to offer, welcoming special guests to chat about all the latest headlines, big TV moments (past and present), and literally every scandal, feud, and Hollywood controversy that’s made us lose our sh*t.
